shellCommands.command: pwd && rg -n "disabled|shouldDirty|dirtyFields|isDirty" src/logic src/useForm.ts src/__tests__/useForm/formState.test.tsx | head -240
git status --short && rg --files src/logic src | head -100
git status --short && find src/logic -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort
sed -n '730,775p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts && sed -n '1035,1080p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts && sed -n '1240,1300p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts
grep -RIn "type GetIsDirty\|GetIsDirty" src/types | head -20 && grep -RIn "_getDirty(" src/logic/createFormControl.ts
grep -RIn "useForm({[[:space:]]*disabled\|disabled: true" src/__tests__ | head -100 && git diff --check && git status --short

tail -c 1 src/logic/createFormControl.ts | od -An -t x1; printf '\n' >> src/logic/createFormControl.ts; node_modules/.bin/jest --config ./scripts/jest/jest.config.js src/__tests__/useForm/formState.test.tsx src/__tests__/useForm/setValue.test.tsx --runInBand
git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/logic/createFormControl.ts src/types/form.ts
tail -c 1 src/types/form.ts | od -An -t x1; node_modules/.bin/prettier --config .prettierrc --check src/logic/createFormControl.ts src/types/form.ts

node_modules/.bin/prettier --config .prettierrc --write src/logic/createFormControl.ts src/types/form.ts && git diff --check && node_modules/.bin/jest --config ./scripts/jest/jest.config.js src/__tests__/useForm/formState.test.tsx src/__tests__/useForm/setValue.test.tsx --runInBand
git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short
